text_block_list.text:
I went to a large park a bit far off
together with Bamboo Memory.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Whoa! What an amazing flower bed! Proof that the caretakers really know their stuff!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm already totally pumped up!
Trainer! Let's head out on an expedition~!

And so, alongside a pumped-up Bamboo Memory,
I walked around the park—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, looks like this area is the obstacle course!
The one in the back is made especially for Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Like swinging across ropes to reach the goal on top of a hill,
or sprinting on floating logs across a whole pond! Sounds super fun!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, brings back memories~
Reminds me of when my dad used to take me
to the obstacle course back in the day!

text_block_list.name: Young Bamboo
text_block_list.text:
Look, look, Dad!
I can even jump all the way
to that far rope over there!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Father
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! A true king of the jungle!
Alright, Dad's gonna give it a shot too!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo & Father
text_block_list.text: Ah~~ aah~~~~♪

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Father
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Amazing, Bamboo!
You're my pride and joy!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, Trainer!
I'm gonna go conquer that obstacle course!
Just watch me!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
HELL YEAAAAHHH!!
How was that, Trainer-san?!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, for real?!
Alright, I'll breeze through the next one too~!

Like a wild child, Bamboo Memory cleared
one obstacle course challenge after another!

text_block_list.name: Watching Girl
text_block_list.text:
Waaah!
That big sister is amazing!
So cool~!

text_block_list.name: Watching Man
text_block_list.text:
Wh... What are those moves!?
It's like she's the king of the jungle...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...! —Heheheh!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm not even close to done yet!
Next time, I'll leap across the ropes using just one hand and reach the goal~!

text_block_list.name: Watching Girl
text_block_list.text:
"Hey hey, big sis!
What're you gonna show me next?"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Right on~! For the next one, how about doing a handstand on a floating log while doing a lap around the pond!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oh! What is it, Trainer-san?
Would a harder one be better?
choice_data_list: It's dangerous if kids try to copy it...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...Gasp?!

—Heyyy!
—That's dangerous, you know!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, everyone! I'm really sorry,
but let's call it a day after all!"

text_block_list.name: Watching Girl
text_block_list.text:
I see~... But thank you!
It was lots of fun!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Man, my bad, really.
I got carried away and went wild again, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Trainer stopping me reminded me.
Ever since I was little, whenever I got fired up, Dad would
praise me. And then I'd always get carried away—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Mother
text_block_list.text: Hey! Both of you, that's dangerous, you know!

text_block_list.name: Young Bamboo
text_block_list.text: Wah, Mom!?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Father
text_block_list.text: S-Sorry... I couldn't help myself...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—And after that,
we always had a debriefing session, ya know.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
When I think about it that way, I really haven't changed at all since the old days, huh...
Ugh, I'm so immature~!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I really gotta get serious about fixing
my habit of going wild, don't I?! Right, Trainer?!
choice_data_list: You should make the most of that passion of yours.
You should definitely make the most of that passion of yours.
Let's carefully assess when to go all out.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I really gotta get serious about fixing
my habit of going wild, don't I?! Right, Trainer?!
choice_data_list: You should make the most of that passion of yours.
You should definitely make the most of that passion of yours.
Let's carefully assess when to go all out.

text_block_list.text:
Losing control is bad, to be sure, but that fiery passion is the very fuel
that drives Bamboo Memory.
There is no need to discard it.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...! That's so true!
I'm not myself unless I'm all fired up!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Don't sweat the small stuff!
Let's just keep showing everyone our fiery passion!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Then let's head back to the obstacle course
and try that challenge we skipped earlier—

Bamboo Memory just can't seem to find a good middle ground...
It looks like she still needs some room to grow.

Races, training, and disciplinary committee duties.
Given the right timing, her passion and
drive will surely produce magnificent results.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! Stuff like that totally feels like...
'commanding your inner power!' or something—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"This is just like a training arc in a shonen manga!
It's totally firing me up~!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, or rather, Master!
I'll train my spirit with everything I've got, so
please guide me~!

Bamboo Memory was all fired up.
It seemed necessary to watch over her
so that her enthusiasm wouldn't run wild.
